capabilities: tag image and video attachments with custom tags
browse all vault media in a paginated gallery grid
edit title, description and tags of the active media file in a sidebar panel
search and filter media by tag, title or description
scan and index vault images or extract images referenced by the current note
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README is bilingual (English and Chinese). Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; data is stored in .obsidian/image-tags.db with automatic migration from a legacy JSON file.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to tag, describe, search or visually browse the image and video attachments in a vault.
summary: Media tag manager that adds tags, descriptions and a gallery view to image and video attachments, storing records in SQLite keyed by file content MD5.
